candidate.user_submission: Pikin dey 2 months old. E get cough, e dey breathe hard for 3 days now. We count im breaths for one full minute when e dey calm, na 49 breaths we see. E no dey convulse now and e never convulse before. E no dey lethargic and e dey conscious. E fit drink or breastfeed. E no dey vomit everything. E no get diarrhoea. E no get ear problem. E no get fever. E chest no dey go inside when e dey breathe. Pulse oximeter no dey. E no dey wheeze and e no get stridor when e dey calm. E no get recurrent wheeze.
